coordinate_frames.control_semantics: linear/angular acceleration prescribed about acccentre; gravity is explicit and remains -9.81 m/s^2
coordinate_frames.position_semantics: native solver position in fixed tank coordinates
coordinate_frames.world_transform: not inferred; no inertial-world trajectory claim

coordinate_frames.control_semantics: tank translation/rotation trajectory prescribed in world time; fluid-relative event coordinates obtained by inverse rigid transform
coordinate_frames.position_semantics: native solver/world position plus saved tank pose at every frame
coordinate_frames.world_transform: p_world = R_tank(t) p_tank + c_tank(t); event planes are defined in p_tank

event_time_window.definition: full drive plus at least three dominant periods when a periodic template is declared, then a stopped-control reflow tail
event_time_window.history_reuse_rule: 8.35 s is reusable only for the same finite prescribed control and observation scope; it is not an automatic window for new mechanisms
event_time_window.periodic_requirement: if frequency_ratio or phase control makes a non-periodic template, report complete finite control and explicit censored tail instead

finite_surfaces.surface: x=0; y in [-0.09,0.09], z in [0,0.51], excluding solid baffle faces
y=0; x in [-0.45,0.45], z in [0,0.51], finite wetted opening only
upstream face of each finite channel; aperture bounds are geometry assets, never an infinite plane
downstream face of each finite channel; channel index is part of event key
finite top rim z=0.51; report legal open exit separately from closed-wall violation

locator.algorithm: saved-frame interval linear chord intersection in the event frame
locator.multiple_crossings: each crossing is an event; net flux is signed mass sum; forward/backward totals are separate
locator.ordering: sort same-interval events by tau, then surface_id, then numerical_id
locator.out_of_domain: closed wall, legal top exit, solver-invalid, numerical loss, and unknown are mutually exclusive categories
locator.tau_definition: tau=(plane_value-p0)/(p1-p0), retain 0<=tau<=1 and interpolate time linearly

required_labels.semantics: region at every saved frame; final location is separate from ever-arrived
first crossing time, NaN only for censored/no event with censor flag
signed sum of native particle masses
repeat crossings retained without creating new particles
integral of valid occupancy; interval-censoring is explicit
final region, legal_open_exit, closed_wall, invalid, numerical_loss, unknown
root cause or censor code, unknown is not zero
mass not classifiable from native state or missing event support

source_regions.denominator: sum of initial fluid mass for all particles in region
source_regions.region: initial fluid particles with tank-frame x < 0

source_regions.denominator: sum of initial fluid mass for all particles in region
source_regions.region: initial fluid particles with tank-frame x >= 0

source_regions.denominator: sum of initial fluid mass for all particles in region
source_regions.region: initial fluid particles with tank-frame y < 0

source_regions.denominator: sum of initial fluid mass for all particles in region
source_regions.region: initial fluid particles with tank-frame y >= 0

source_regions.denominator: initial mass per connected component; channel particles remain source-labelled by initial component
source_regions.region: baffle geometry connected components at t=0, with explicit channel ownership
